Post-process and cursor shaders need the terminal texture or cursor uniforms and are not portable to the Holodeck runtime. Generators port by deleting the final terminal blend.

requirements: Shadertoy-style mainImage; iChannel0 is the terminal contents
Cursor shaders use iCurrentCursor, iPreviousCursor, iTimeCursorChange
Generators only use iChannel0 to blend over dark terminal pixels
